title: What's New: Financial Management (2024 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Subscription Billing Features and Future Enhancements
Default Quantity for G/L Lines Feature

features.name: Subscription Billing Module
features.description: A new module that allows you to do recurring invoicing for contracts and services provided to customers, with capabilities to set frequency, periods, renewal and expiry dates, control revenue recognition through deferral modules, and manage recurring billing periods.

features.name: Subscription Billing Excel Reports
features.description: Excel reports for subscription billing that will be provided in version 25.2, in addition to standard reports that come with the module.

features.name: Subscription Billing Word Layout and Power BI App
features.description: A new word layout and a Power BI app for subscription billing that will provide embedded Power BI reporting for the module.
features.status_evidence_quote: embedded powerbi reporting for subscription billing but that will be in the next minor

features.name: Automated Subscription Billing
features.description: Automated billing capability that allows you to set up subscription billing once and let it run automatically.
features.status_evidence_quote: maybe the next release we will also do automated building so you can set it up once

features.name: Default Quantity for G/L Lines
features.description: A small toggle feature in sales and receivables or purchase and payables setup that sets the default quantity for G/L lines to one, similar to the item default quantity feature.

features.name: Power BI Apps for Financial Areas
features.description: Power BI apps that will be delivered for six areas including Finance, Sales and Purchase. The Finance Power BI app includes 14 reports that will be embedded in the product with overview, KPIs and ledger entry drill-down capabilities.

features.name: Fixed Assets Query with Star Schema
features.description: A query based on a star schema for fixed assets that allows you to query fixed asset ledger entries and create your own views. It queries multiple tables simultaneously for fact-finding and data validation purposes.

features.name: Financial Reporting Module Templates
features.description: Additional templates added to the financial reporting module where you can combine row definitions with column definitions to create custom reports. Five predefined reports are included: balance sheet, income statement (detailed and summarized), and trial balance.
